datasets.raw_shift_interval: 15-minute discrete time slots (up to 96 slots per 24-hour day)
datasets.active_operating_intervals_sample: 72 intervals/day (06:00 to 24:00 active operating hours in instance 1_7_10_1)
datasets.original_file_format: Structured plain text (SECTION_HORIZON, SECTION_TASKS, SECTION_STAFF, SECTION_COVER)
datasets.adaptation_details: Each 15-minute active interval with positive demand is mapped into a discrete Ordivanta Shift. Staff minimum/maximum minutes map to individual employee maximum hours caps. Section cover demands map to cell required headcount.
supported_constraints: Workstation staffing headcount demand (>= required)
Maximum working minutes/hours per employee
Task-specific qualification skill matching
Single assignment per employee per 15-minute slot
Temporal non-overlapping shifts with rest margins
omitted_or_approximated_constraints: Overstaffing ceiling penalty (Ordivanta optimizes coverage as hard constraint)
